satisfaction_reasons: Current overall quality 1307/180 = 7.26(1), half-up 7.3; the 8.0 line needs an exact mean of at least 7.95.

The fde2314 changes visibly answer most of my round-2 findings (submits now primary, quiet phone Remove, chevron disclosure, checkbox/help in the input column, DHCP quote glyph, Settings Save edge, scroll caption). My lower scores fall mainly on pixels that did not change, so round-over-round movement (-0.3) is reviewer variation, not regression. Under either round's calibration the gate is unmet (round 2 7.6, round 3 7.3).

Remaining defects are concrete and repeated across list pages: orange header jump links outside the accent roles, mixed mono/sans cell sizes and placeholders, staggered phone label grids, mid-token URL breaks, and dark-theme danger/accent hues that read nearly alike.
9/10 is not achieved; behaviour gates untested.

strongest_findings.finding: Header jump links are orange underlined text, so each list page shows two accent marks (link + filled submit); on Blacklists the link is the only orange above the fold.
Danger salmon Remove (outline on desktop, text on phone) sits beside the orange link/button at nearly the same hue; destructive and primary blur at a glance.
Rows mix 14px mono values with 15px sans 'all views' on a lower baseline; Records placeholders switch face (Name mono, Value sans); the Records precedence note sits at x=280 outside the form column.
Two-column label/value rows sit on staggered baselines and Remove floats below its row.
Source URL still breaks mid-token (StevenBla|ck); one row mixes four type styles; four equal outlined buttons with no visible primary above the fold.
Counts repeat across KPI strip, legend and table; orange doubles as the Forwarded series hue (declined and retained by owner; recorded, not re-argued).
The 'Scroll navigation' caption reads like a product tagline in the wordmark slot; it answers the cue finding but differs from the KyIdentity header (subtitle/account).
Three stacked headings (Settings / Server settings / Zone) precede the first field.

recommended_batch.scope: One bounded consistency batch on list pages; no new features, copy claims, routes or behaviour changes.
items: Header jump links: neutral ink, underlined tertiary links, so orange marks only the submit, selection and focus.
Row typography: render 'all views'/View cells at the same size and baseline as the mono values (or both meta 13px); give Records placeholders one face; move the precedence note into the form column.
Phone label grids (Services/Records/Blacklists): one row track per label pair so left/right baselines align; Remove on the last row's baseline.
Blacklists URL: allow breaks only after '/' (e.g. <wbr> after slashes) instead of mid-token.
Dark danger vs accent: raise upstream in ky-ui (shared token), not a product override; out of this product batch.
recommended_batch.expectation: Even a clean execution is unlikely to add the +0.69 mean needed for 7.95 under this round's scoring; the outcome is unknown until recaptured and blind-scored.

scope: Static image review only. No product edits, builds, tests, browsers, installs, server mutation, subagents, commits, pushes, PR, MySlop or Gemini calls. Outputs: opus-round3.json and opus-round3.md only.
